rows.text: The Assembly's news item created on 24 February 2015 reports a recent trade and investment trip to Zhoushan City, China, 'led by Lord Speaker of the Legislative Assembly of Tonga, Lord Tu'ivakano'; its photograph captions print 'Hon. Speaker, Lord Tu'ivakano', and it lists 'Lord Tu'ivakano (Head of the Delegation) Hon. Speaker of Parliament'.
rows.locator: Article header ('Created: 24 February 2015'); photograph captions; paragraph 1; the delegation list
rows.uncertainty: Contemporaneous styling by the Assembly's own news service; it attests the holder in office on the item's creation date only. The item dates the trip 'from February 10-18' without printing the year on that line. It dates neither the Assembly's election of the Speaker after the 2014 election, nor a royal appointment, nor an oath; no source retrieved for this packet dates any of the three for the 2014 Assembly.
